procedure: Run the 100 held-out seeds only after the 80 known ones are confirmed. After reading the held-out results, do not change the bot because of them. Known: the kept trials of the old version and stage 3 of the new one, every exit replayed again. The 20 extra earlier seeds serve only as a development regression check.
note: The sha256 values were recomputed on 2026-11-16, after the files were translated to English (names, comments, strings; the bot plays the same games to the tic). They are the hashes of the files as a Windows clone checks them out (CRLF line endings). The agent's original freeze, with the Polish file names, is in the tag etap-8.
